_**Agent (grok-4.6)**_

The 500s are not an Ubuntu vs Windows runtime difference. The production image never ships the ETL package the Flask parquet loader started importing.

**What happens:** every parquet read goes through `ensure_competition_core_columns_for_read` → `canonicalize_club_label` → `data_access.clubs_registry`. That module did `from scripts.data.extract_excel_data import normalize_team_name`. Locally the full repo is on disk, so the import works. The Dockerfile only copies `scripts/publish_tournament_parquet.py`, so on the VPS `scripts.data` does not exist and data load 500s (`/league/get_club_matrix`, `/player/get_club_300`, …).

**Fix:** `normalize_team_name` now lives in `data_access/team_name_normalization.py` (same pattern as player-name normalization). `clubs_registry` imports it from there. The extract script re-exports the same functions so league merge is unchanged. Docker does not need to copy `scripts/`.

Redeploy this build. The `League cache MISS for get_club_matrix` line in the same log is a follow-on of the failed load; after the import is gone, if that miss is still there with a 500, run `deploy -SyncCache` (or `scripts/warm_league_cache.py`).
